events.text: P: Hi. To the airport, please. No rush, my flight is in three hours.

D: Uh oh. Hmm. That's not good. The engine just cut out. P: Oh. Is everything okay? D: Yeah, yeah, nothing dangerous. Sorry about this. Give me a couple of minutes, I need to check what the problem is. P: Sure, take your time. I'm not in a hurry.
D: Okay, I think it's just the battery cable. One more minute and we can go. P: No worries at all.
